text: Chapter 2 - The Power of the Summoner
Summoning has always been considered taboo. This can be traced back to the time of the Necromancer Wars.
zh: 召唤术历来被视为禁忌。这可以追溯到死灵法师战争的年代。

text: However, after the wars ended and summoning magic was regulated, attitudes towards it improved.
zh: 然而，随着战争结束、召唤魔法受到管制，人们对它的态度有所改观。

text: While almost everything could be summoned, before the regulation of summoning magic, today there are special limitations to protect others, as well as the summoner, from unwanted effects.
zh: 在召唤魔法受管制之前，几乎万物皆可召唤；而如今则设有特殊限制，以保护他人乃至召唤师本人免受不良影响。

text: Most summons are limited to one at a time, of the same type.
zh: 大多数召唤物同一类型每次仅限一个。

text:
The exception to this rule is so-called "lesser" summons.
These can be summoned multiple times at the same time.
zh:
此规则的例外是所谓的“次级”召唤物。
它们可以同时召唤出多个。

text: It should be noted that the summoning time is reduced by the number of lesser summons, as the summoner must command several individuals at the same time.
zh: 需要注意的是，召唤持续时间会随次级召唤物的数量增多而缩短，因为召唤师必须同时统御多个个体。

text: Sazzou, one of the first summoners, learned about the influence of the summoners power to the summoned individual.
zh: 最早的召唤师之一萨佐，发现了召唤师自身力量对被召唤个体的影响。

text: While the summoner's Magic extends the duration of the summoned being, the Intelligence directly affects their strength.
zh: 召唤师的魔力可以延长召唤物的存在时间，而智力则直接影响它们的强度。

text: Rune stones, as well as magical staves that are imbued with summoning magic, are strictly controlled and must fulfill a number of requirements before they reach the hands of magicians.
zh: 蕴含召唤魔法的符文石与魔法法杖都受到严格管控，必须满足一系列要求，方能交到魔法师手中。
